wipe.title: Delete local profiles
wipe.warning: This will delete all local databases, keys, and saved accounts on this device. Your remote account is not affected.

secretKey.warnIntro: You will be presented with a Secret Key — the only way to sign in on a new device without access to an existing one.
secretKey.warnOnce: It is shown <emph>once</emph> and never stored. If you lose it and every device, the account is unrecoverable.
secretKey.warnPrepare: Have a password manager open, or be ready to print or write it down somewhere safe.
secretKey.acknowledge: I understand, show me the key
secretKey.showSubtitle: Save this somewhere safe. You will not see it again.
secretKey.confirmSubtitle: Paste the key you just saved to prove you can retrieve it.

emergencyKit.document:
POLLIS — EMERGENCY KIT
======================

Your Secret Key is the only way to recover access to your account
from a new device when you don't have any other Pollis device with
you. Treat it like a master password.

If you lose this key AND lose access to all of your devices,
your account is unrecoverable. Pollis cannot reset it for you.

  SECRET KEY:

    {{secretKey}}

Store this file somewhere safe (a password manager, encrypted
backup, or printed and locked away). Anyone with this key + your
email address can sign in as you on a new device.

Generated: {{generated}}

pinCreate.headline: Set a PIN
pinCreate.subline: 4 digits. You'll use it to unlock Pollis on this device.
pinCreate.confirmSubline: Enter the PIN again to confirm.

pinEntry.headline: Enter PIN
pinEntry.forgot: Forgot PIN? Recover with Secret Key

enroll.title: Authorize this device to add it to your account
enroll.approveHint: You'll see a verification code here. Open Pollis on a device you're already signed in to and confirm the code.
enroll.useSecretKeyHint: For when you don't have any other Pollis device with you.
enroll.cancelAndSwitch: Cancel and sign in as someone else
enroll.awaitingIntro: Open Pollis on another device that's already signed in. You'll see a prompt asking you to confirm this code:
enroll.rejectedBody: One of your other devices rejected this enrollment. If that wasn't you, change your email password immediately.
enroll.expiredBody: The 10-minute approval window passed. You can start a new request.

recover.intro: Paste the Secret Key from your Emergency Kit.
recover.hint: Recovery can take a few seconds while this device is registered.
recover.wantReset: I've lost my Secret Key — reset my account

reset.title: Reset this account
reset.body: Your messages on this device will be wiped for good. You'll leave your groups (admins can invite you back) and your other devices will be signed out.
reset.keepNote: You'll keep your email and username, and a new Secret Key will be shown once. Save it somewhere safe — lose it and the only way back in is to do all of this again.
reset.acknowledge: I understand that all of my messages will be removed from this device and I will be removed from all of my groups and conversations.

approval.title: A new device wants to enroll
approval.body: A device claiming to be yours (id {{deviceId}}) just signed in with your email and is asking to be added to your account.
approval.instruction: Only approve if you started this on another device just now. The code below MUST match the code shown on the new device. If it doesn't match, reject this request.

shell.signOutQuestion: Do you want to delete your locally stored messages and keys?
